part: Part A — Before you start
section: What you need & Important tips
summary: Hardware, browser, credential requirements and critical security/offline tips before launching POS.
steps: 1. Prepare computer, laptop, or tablet with internet connection.
2. Install Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge browser (recommended).
3. Obtain Company Code (given by Isarva).
4. Obtain Admin username and password / PIN (given by Isarva).
5. Have restaurant name, VAT / tax details, and branch address ready.
key_notes: Keep your password secret. Do not share it with everyone.
Always select the correct branch before taking orders.
If the screen shows Offline, you can still take some orders; sync occurs when internet returns.
CRITICAL: Do not store customer card numbers in order notes.
full_text:
Part A — Before you start | What you need & Important tips
Module: General / Prerequisites | Location: Pre-requisite / Browser
Target Roles: Restaurant Owner, Admin, Staff
Summary: Hardware, browser, credential requirements and critical security/offline tips before launching POS.
Steps:
1. Prepare computer, laptop, or tablet with internet connection.
2. Install Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge browser (recommended).
3. Obtain Company Code (given by Isarva).
4. Obtain Admin username and password / PIN (given by Isarva).
5. Have restaurant name, VAT / tax details, and branch address ready.
Important Notes:
- Keep your password secret. Do not share it with everyone.
- Always select the correct branch before taking orders.
- If the screen shows Offline, you can still take some orders; sync occurs when internet returns.
- CRITICAL: Do not store customer card numbers in order notes.

part: Part B — First-time setup
section: Step 1-2: Open POS website & Activate POS
summary: Initial till activation binding the browser/device permanently to the restaurant via Company Code.
steps: 1. Open browser and navigate to https://app.restaurant-pos.isarva.in
2. Wait for login / activate screen.
3. Locate Activate POS (or company code box).
4. Enter Company Code given by Isarva (e.g. C001, or registered VAT/tax ID, min 3 chars).
5. Click 'Activate POS' and wait until restaurant name is displayed.
6. If activation fails, re-check code or contact Isarva support.
key_notes: After activation, this till belongs to your restaurant only.

troubleshooting.solution: Check company code and internet connection; contact Isarva support if issue persists.

part: Part B — First-time setup
section: Step 3-6: Sign in as Admin, Language & Company Details / ZATCA
summary: Admin initial login, bilingual language toggle (EN/AR), company and branch configuration, and ZATCA KSA tax details.
steps: 1. Enter Admin username and PIN or password to sign in to Home menu.
2. (Optional) Switch language between EN / AR at any time.
3. Open Settings -> Company & Branches; verify company name, logo, VAT details.
4. Add each restaurant branch (name, address, phone) and Save.
5. On top bar, verify the correct branch is selected for this till.
6. Open Settings -> Company Details (ZATCA/tax section) and enter legal name, address, and VAT number.
7. Complete ZATCA Phase 2 onboarding (OTP, CSID) strictly under Isarva support guidance.
key_notes: Day close, tables, and stock operate per branch. Always confirm branch before starting.
Never share ZATCA private keys over WhatsApp or email.

troubleshooting.solution: Check Caps Lock, click Refresh on login screen, and confirm with Isarva if user is active.

part: Part B — First-time setup
section: Step 7-11: Menu Masters, Tables, Users, Hardware & End-to-End Test
summary: Rapid setup sequence for dishes, floor tables, staff users, printers, and verification test order.

part: Part C — Daily opening checklist

summary: Essential 7-step checklist performed every morning before taking live orders.
steps: 1. Open the POS website in browser.

part: Part D — How to take a dine-in order (Floor)
section: Step 1-3: Table Seating, Adding Items & Bill Totals
where: Dine-in Floor Map -> Order Ticket Panel
summary: Opening a table, selecting categories and items, specifying notes/addons, and understanding bill totals (Subtotal, Discount, Charges, VAT).
steps: 1. Tap 'Dine-in' from the navigation.
2. Tap the guest table and seat table (input guest count if prompted).
3. Select category, tap dish, choose quantity, add custom notes ('No onion', 'Less spicy').
4. Select add-ons and click Add to Order.
5. Review ticket summary: Subtotal -> Discount (%) -> Extra charges -> VAT / Tax -> Total (VAT inclusive).
key_notes: Tax is automatically calculated from backend Tax settings. You do not manually type tax on the floor.
To modify tax rates, Admin must adjust in Settings -> Tax.

troubleshooting.solution: Admin must attach the addon group to the dish in Masters -> Dishes / Addons.

part: Part D — How to take a dine-in order (Floor)
section: Step 4-5: Applying Discounts and Extra Charges
summary: Applying discount percentage buttons and toggling extra charges (service fee, parking, packing).
steps: 1. Open active table ticket with items.
2. In DISCOUNT row, tap desired percentage button (e.g. 0%, 7%, 10%). Active button highlights dark.
3. Verify discount amount and net Total update immediately. Tap 0% to remove.
4. In EXTRA CHARGES row, tap charge pill to toggle ON (e.g. Service charge SAR 150.00).
5. Tap pill again to turn OFF.
6. System automatically handles configured tax on extra charges.
key_notes: Only apply discounts if authorized by shop policy.
Extra charges must first be created and set Active in Settings -> Extra Charges.

troubleshooting.solution: Admin must define discount percentages in Settings -> Discount; then reopen table.
Admin must create charge in Settings -> Extra Charges and ensure Active is checked.

part: Part D — How to take a dine-in order (Floor)
section: Step 6-7: Save vs Save & Print vs Save & Bill vs KOT
summary: Differences between ticket draft saving options and sending food orders to the kitchen via KOT.
steps: 1. 'Save': Persists ticket in system without exiting order state (when guests will order more later).
2. 'Save & Print': Persists ticket and prints an interim order slip.
3. 'Save & Bill': Saves and prints a temporary bill preview for guest review prior to payment.
4. 'KOT' (Kitchen Order Ticket): Sends pending items to KDS screen / kitchen printer. The button displays pending count e.g. KOT (2).
5. 'KOT & Print': Sends pending items to kitchen and simultaneously produces a physical paper kitchen slip.
key_notes: CRITICAL: Never only 'Save' if the kitchen needs to cook. Always press KOT for new food orders.
Buttons remain disabled if ticket has no items.

troubleshooting.solution: Go to Settings -> Printer -> Printer Mapping and assign departments to the correct printer station.

part: Part D — How to take a dine-in order (Floor)
section: Step 8-10: Change Table, Merge Tables & Split Initiator
summary: Transferring active orders to another table, merging multiple tables into one host check, or initiating bill splitting.
steps: 1. Change Table: Open ticket -> Tap 'Change Table' -> Select target empty table -> Confirm. Original table frees up instantly.
2. Merge Tables: Open host table -> Tap 'Merge Tables' -> Select table(s) to combine -> Confirm. Floor displays 'Merged' badge.
3. Split: Open ticket -> Verify subtotal and taxes -> Tap 'Split' to launch Settle dialog in split payment mode.
key_notes: Always verify with guests before merging tables.
After merging, settle payment on the host table.
Requires 'Change Table' privilege enabled in Role Privileges.

troubleshooting.solution: Verify that user role has 'Change Table' permission enabled in Settings -> Role Privilege.

part: Part E — Settle screen
section: E1-E2: Settle Overview & Single Tender Full Payment
summary: Navigating the Settle modal, understanding remaining balance, quick payment buttons, and completing single-method transactions.
steps: 1. Tap 'Settle' (primary brown pay button) from table ticket.
2. Modal displays 'Amount due ... incl. VAT' and 'Remaining bar'.
3. For quick 1-touch pay: Tap 'Rest -> Cash', 'Rest -> mada', 'Rest -> Visa / Mastercard', or 'Rest -> Apple Pay'.
4. Alternatively: Select payment type from dropdown, tap 'Fill remaining', then tap 'Add'.
5. Once Remaining reaches SAR 0.00, tap 'Confirm pay' (or Settle).
6. Hand receipt to guest. Table status resets to free immediately.
key_notes: The Confirm Settle button only activates when Remaining balance is exactly SAR 0.00.
VAT is already incorporated in the amount due.

troubleshooting.solution: Logged-in user requires Settle permission (typically Cashier or Admin role).
Remaining balance is greater than 0. Add tender lines until Remaining is SAR 0.00.

part: Part E — Settle screen
section: E3-E4: Equal Split and Custom Multi-Method Split
summary: Dividing bills equally across multiple guests or splitting across mixed tenders (e.g. SAR 200 cash + rest on mada card).
steps: 1. Equal Split: Tap 'Equal' tab -> Select number of guests (2, 3, 4...) -> Process each share via cash/card until Remaining is 0 -> Confirm.
2. Custom Split: Tap 'Custom' tab -> Choose method (e.g. Cash) -> Enter amount (or tap 'Half remaining') -> Tap 'Add'.
3. Select next tender (e.g. mada) -> Tap 'Fill remaining' -> Tap 'Add'.
4. When Remaining displays SAR 0.00, tap 'Confirm split'.
key_notes: If an erroneous line is added, remove the line and re-enter payment.
Never force-close modal during unsettled split payment.

troubleshooting.problem: Payment fails or wrong split amount
troubleshooting.solution: Keep ticket open; remove wrong payment line in list, re-enter correct amount, and retry.

part: Part E — Settle screen
section: E5-E8: Food Vouchers, Gift Cards, Loyalty Points & SoftPOS
where: Settle Modal -> Vouchers / Gift Cards / Loyalty
summary: Redeeming food vouchers, gift cards, loyalty points, and processing integrated card / SoftPOS payments.
steps: 1. Food Voucher: Select Food Voucher tender -> Enter or scan voucher code -> Verify applied discount -> Settle remaining via cash/card.
2. Gift Card: Select Gift Card option -> Enter or scan card number -> Apply balance -> Pay remaining if needed -> Confirm.
3. Loyalty Points: Search/select customer profile -> Enter points to redeem -> Due balance reduces -> Settle remaining balance.
4. Card / SoftPOS / Wallets: Select mada/Visa/Apple Pay/STC Pay -> Follow terminal prompt -> Wait for official approval confirmation.
key_notes: Used vouchers cannot and must not be reused.
Card terminals require a live active local bridge service.
Demo simulate mode must remain OFF for live production sales.

troubleshooting.solution: Confirm voucher was created in Settings -> Food vouchers and voucher code is entered accurately.
Check SoftPOS bridge connectivity and ensure training simulate mode is turned off in Settings -> Card / SoftPOS.

part: Part F & G — Takeaway, Drive-thru, Delivery & QR Orders
section: Takeaway, Drive-thru, Aggregators & Guest QR Menu
summary: Managing takeaway parcels, drive-thru vehicle lanes, aggregator APIs (HungerStation, Jahez, Keeta), and self-service QR menus.
steps: 1. Takeaway / Drive-thru: Tap module -> Create new order -> Add items -> Send to kitchen -> Collect payment -> Mark complete upon pickup.

QR menu link must include the unique restaurant company code.

part: Part H & I — Kitchen Screen (KDS) & Delivery Rider
section: Kitchen Manager KDS & Rider Dispatch Flow
summary: Operating the kitchen display system (KDS station filtering, bumping tickets, 86 stock-outs) and rider mobile dispatch tracking.
steps: 1. Kitchen Screen: Sign in as Kitchen Manager -> Filter board by All / Kitchen / Bar / Expo -> Read item notes (allergies/spice).
2. Bump Items: Tap item to mark started -> Tap 'Done' (bump) when cooking is complete.
3. Stock-Out (86): If an ingredient runs out, immediately flag item 86 to Admin and floor staff.
4. Rider Dispatch: Rider logs in on mobile (using last 4 digits of phone) -> Select assigned order -> Mark 'Started' upon departure -> Mark 'Delivered' upon handover.
5. Hand over COD (Cash on Delivery) cash to cashier upon returning.
key_notes: Do not bump tickets belonging to other preparation stations.
Riders must never discard undelivered food without explicit Admin approval.

part: Part J & P — Day Close, Cash Drawer Shifts & Financial Hub
section: Day Close, Cash Count, Drawer Shift & Sales Ledger
where: Back Office -> Day Close / Sales / Shift
summary: Daily end-of-day closing protocol, physical drawer cash reconciliation, shift management, and ledger auditing.
steps: 1. Ensure all open table tickets and unsettled delivery orders are resolved.
2. Open Back Office -> Day Close (or Accounts hub).
3. Physically count currency in cash drawer.
4. Open Sales Ledger to review system tender totals (Cash vs Card vs Online).
5. Enter counted cash amount into system reconciliation field.
6. Confirm Day Close for the designated branch.
7. Print and archive the Day Close summary report for accounting.
key_notes: Day close is strictly executed per branch.
Cash drawer Shift (open/close count) is distinct from staff employee time clock attendance.

part: Part Q & R — Ingredients & Inventory (Stock Control)
section: Raw Materials, Recipes, POs, Receiving, Transfers & Stock Master
summary: Full inventory lifecycle: raw material SKUs, bill of materials (recipes), yield conversion factors, purchase orders, receiving goods, and stock audits.
steps: 1. Ingredient Master (Q1): Define raw ingredients, SKUs, measurement units, and preferred suppliers.
2. Dish Recipes (Q2-Q3): Link ingredients and portion weights to menu items for automated food-cost tracking and stock deduction.
3. Storage Locations & Yields (R1-R2): Create locations (Main Store, Kitchen, Walk-in) and yield formulas (whole chicken -> cleaned chicken).
4. Purchase Orders & Stock Receiving (R3, R5): Raise POs to vendors; inspect goods and record receipt on Stock Receiving screen.
5. Stock Transfers & Master (R4, R6): Move stock between store and kitchen; reconcile on-hand quantities via Stock Master physical counts.
key_notes: Stock quantity only increments upon formal Stock Receiving (creating a PO alone does not increment stock).
Never record stock transfers in system without executing physical movement.

troubleshooting.solution: Execute Stock Receiving against the PO; PO creation alone does not increase stock.
Audit recipe quantities and ingredient unit conversions in Settings -> Recipe usage.

section: Master Troubleshooting Matrix (All 19 Scenarios)
summary: Rapid diagnosis and direct remediation steps for all 19 documented field issues.
steps: 1. Addon not showing on order -> Attach addon to dish in Masters / Addons.
2. Discount buttons missing -> Admin: Settings -> Discount; reopen table.
3. Extra charges missing on floor -> Admin: Settings -> Extra Charges, set Active.
4. Tax looks wrong on bill -> Admin: Settings -> Tax / Menu details; do not edit tax on floor.
5. Change Table / Merge not visible -> User role requires 'Change Table' permission.
6. Split / Settle not visible -> User role requires 'Settle' permission (Cashier/Admin).
7. Confirm split is grey -> Remaining balance is not 0; add tender lines until SAR 0.00.
8. Food voucher not applying -> Create voucher in Settings; verify code entered on Settle.
9. KOT on wrong printer -> Reconfigure Settings -> Printer -> Printer Mapping.
10. Stock not increasing after delivery -> Execute Stock Receiving (PO alone does not add stock).
11. Transfer done but qty wrong -> Check from/to location and complete transfer.
12. Report empty -> Verify date range and active branch selection.
13. Staff cannot open Stock -> Enable Stock permission in Settings -> Role Privilege.
14. Card pay always fails -> Check SoftPOS bridge; disable training simulate mode.
15. Online order not coming -> Test Delivery API connection; inspect channel credentials.
16. Food cost report looks wrong -> Audit recipe ingredient weights and unit conversions.
17. Tile says coming later -> Feature under scheduled roadmap; bypass.
18. Cannot activate POS -> Check company code and internet; contact Isarva support.
19. Wrong branch orders -> Switch branch on top bar dropdown before proceeding.
key_notes: Always check user privileges and active branch selection first when diagnosing errors.

part: Part X & Y — Closing Checklist & Security Rules
section: Nightly Closing Protocol & Core Security Policies
summary: Mandatory 5-step daily closing checklist and 6 customer security directives for safeguarding financial and customer data.
steps: Closing Protocol:
1. Settle all remaining tables and unsettled open tabs.
2. Complete or properly hand over all open delivery/online orders.
3. Review Payments Received and Sales Summary reports.
4. Execute authorized Day Close for the branch.
5. Sign out of Admin. Never leave terminals unlocked overnight.
Security Directives:
1. Each staff member must use distinct individual login credentials.
2. Lock screen or sign out when leaving counter unattended.
3. Strictly forbid sharing Admin passwords on WhatsApp groups.
4. Immediately deactivate terminated employee accounts.
5. NEVER store customer credit card numbers in order notes.
6. Immediately report unexpected logins or cash discrepancies to Owner.
key_notes: Never leave terminals logged in as Admin overnight.
Never record customer credit card numbers anywhere in order notes.
